name: Reel
text: Do the 48-hour user interview sprint on sleep optimization now. The transcript for *The Science of S* is already pending; running the sprint first gives us real user data to anchor the product decisions in the video. Trade-off: we delay transcript work, but the sprint’s insights will make the transcript’s product section sharper and more actionable.

name: Scriv
text: The risk isn’t just delaying transcript work—it’s locking the sprint into a single user slice before we know if sleep optimization even matters to our core users. A better alternative: run the sprint on the *pending* transcript first, then use those insights to shape the next sprint’s focus. Settle it by testing both paths: measure how many sleep-related insights come from the sprint versus the transcript, and which delivers faster product clarity.
